parsed.name: ACQ2106高速数据采集机箱（MGTDRAM8）
parsed.name_en: ACQ2106 High-Speed Data Acquisition Chassis with MGTDRAM8
parsed.description: 一款模块化高速数据采集机箱，可配合 MGTDRAM8 高速存储/传输功能进行瞬态波形采集、缓存与读出。常用于物理实验、脉冲测试和其他需要多通道高速记录与事后取数的测量场景。
parsed.description_en: A modular high-speed data acquisition chassis that works with the MGTDRAM8 high-speed storage/transfer function for transient waveform capture, buffering, and readout. It is used in physics experiments, pulsed tests, and other measurements that require multi-channel high-speed recording and post-shot data retrieval.

actions.description: 启动 MGTDRAM8 高速数据采集流程。
actions.description_en: Start the MGTDRAM8 high-speed data acquisition sequence.

actions.description: 准备从 MGTDRAM8 存储区读出数据。
actions.description_en: Prepare data readout from the MGTDRAM8 memory.
